authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2530 eṣa groups the proximal paradigm, with Hindi yah/is, Gujarati e, eastern e/i, and explicit Khowar hes. Survey y/j forms and proximal plurals are paradigm continuations with analogical remodeling; no direct mechanical derivation of each inflected form from nominative eṣa is asserted. The exact regional route may include borrowing between Indo-Aryan languages; the supported family is linked under the user’s preference.
